masterStyle: Cozy dusk fantasy game art in a crisp, high-resolution pixel-art style: chunky stepped shading, limited colours per object, a strong dark brown outline, light from the top left with a warm rim light on the right. assets.prompt: A painted fantasy world map of one valley, seen from above at a slight angle like an illustrated storybook map, portrait format. Dusk lighting with warm lantern points. Layout (keep these positions exactly): Stonecrest Hills, grey rocky hills with small mine entrances, fill the top third of the map. Greywood, a dense dark-green forest of oaks and willows, fills the left side of the middle third. Millbrook, a tiny village of thatched cottages with a water mill, sits in the centre of the middle third. A river flows from the top right down through Millbrook and the forest edge to the bottom. The Sunken Bog, murky green-brown wetland with dead trees and a tiny half-sunken bell tower, fills the bottom third, slightly to the right. A winding dirt road links Millbrook north up to the hills and south down to the bog. Parchment-coloured edges fading into the painting. No text, no labels, no compass letters, no characters.
